tei:div.tei:p: (1na)rje mar pa dang rje btsun mi la'i rnam thar bzhugs so//

"$ (1ba)de'i sras su gyur pa mar pa lo ts+tsha ba 'di nyid yin te/ de gzhon pa'i dus mi thams cad dang 'thab pa la dga' ba cig yin pas/ pha'i bsam pa la nga'i 'dis mi gsod dam/ yang na 'di mis gsod nges pas/ 'di slob gnyer la btang na shes pa bye ba srid snyam nas/ ka ca mang po bskur nas 'brog mi lo ts+tsha ba can du btang ste/ der 'brog mi la rta cig phul nas chos nyan pa la/ 'brog mi lo ts+tsha ba chos la dam par byung nas/ bal yul du byon nas bal po spyi ther ba la chos nyan tsa na/ bal po kun yang rgya gar du chos nyan du 'gro yin 'dug nas/ der cis te mi 'gro snyam nas rgya gar du byon/ de dang po bla ma pen+ta pa dang*/ karma tsa zhes bya ba dang mjal nas lo gsum bsten/ de nas bod kyi byang gser kha tshun chad du byon nas/ pen+ta pa la gser srang gsum phul bas shin tu mnyes nas/ nga la bla ma nā ro pa bya ba yod pas khyod der bskyal gyis gsungs nas/ bi kra ma la shī lar sprad pa yin gsung*/ de nas nā ro pa dang mai tri pa (2na)la sogs pa la chos gsan gsung*/ yon tan gyi dbang du byas na/ nā ro pa'i spyan sngar lo drug bzhugs pa la sun pa cig kyang ma byung ba yin/ bsod nams bsags pa'i rtags nā ro pa dang mjal ba gcig pus chog pa yin gsung*/ de nas bshad rgyud dang sgrub brgyud kyi man ngag rnams bsgoms nas bod du byon pa'i lam khar chos bag re bshad/ dbus su mar pa mgo yags kyis gser srang bcu phul nas chos zhus/ de nas bsnubs la mtsho la brgal nas man ngag yig chung rnams chu la shor/ gnyos lo ts+tsha bas phrag dog byas nas chu bo gaṅgā la bskur zer ba yang yod/ yang log nas bla ma tshol du phyin pa la/ bla ma nags su spyod pa la gshegs nas ma rnyed/ tha ma rnyed tsa na gsung ngag bcad nas ma gnang*/ bla ma chos mi 'chad par rdzas ci yod spong dag byas nas thod pa cig las ma bzung bar 'dug /tshogs dpon dang byin rlabs tsam gnang*/

bla ma mar pa slob ma rnying pa yin pas/ thod pa de yang gnang*/ der lo gnyis bzhugs nas yang dang yang du zhu ba phul bas/ de nas gdod sngar bas bag rtsing ba gnang (2ba)ba yin gsung*/ de nas lho brag tu byon nas bzhugs tsa na/ gtsang rong gi mes ston tshon pos zhing bre drug gis nor gyis bkang nas phul/ chos zhus/ dge bshes gzhung pas dge bshes dgyer chung ba la gsang sngags rnying ma gsan cing bzhugs tsa na/ dge bshes dgyer chung bas bla ma lho pa'i lo rgyus thos pas/ rngog la rang cag gnyis khong la chos nyan du 'deng gsung nas/ der lho brag tu dpon g.yog lngas phyin pas/ bla ma mar pa la rta cig phul/ bla mas ku re gsung*/ khyod kyi rta 'di phyag rten yin na che 'bul ba yin na chung gsung*/ der chos gsan pas gdams pa shin tu che bar dgongs nas mes tshon pos kyang btsun pa btang nas gtsang du byon pa'i zhu ba phul bas/ mar pa lho brag pa yar bzhud pa'i thugs dgongs byas/ gzhud pa'i bsam pa la/ nga ni gtsang du mi thon pha ma gnyis kyang yod/ chos kyang 'phros 'dug pas bsdad snyam nas gzhud du gshegs par zhus pas rung gsung nas/ der byon 'bri gnag bdun cu tham pa/ sbra cig khyi cig /dkar yol cig dang bcas pa phul/ de nas phyis mi las g.yog byas lug brgya dum cig kyang phul/ gsung rab phal chen cig gis sna drangs pa po ti brgyad cu phul/ de rnams phul bas bla mas kyang chos gdan bzhi/ ma hā mā yā/ gur/ dgyes rdor la sogs pa gnang gsung*/ de min yang mi che rgu thams cad kyis zhabs tog byas nas chos zhus pas gdams pa gnang ba lags gsung*/ de nas dus cig na slob ma rnams bsags nas khyim zhig tu bug pa dang*/ skar khung bkag nas/ phug ron ro la rnam shes bcug nas 'phur la khad mdzad pa yin/ yang dus cig na g.yag cig lhog pas shi nas 'dug pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas g.yag shi nas gda' 'am gsung*/ 'khor zhig gis shi nas gda' byas pas/

bla ma g.yang shun hrul po zhig bsnams nas bzhugs tsa na/ yangs pa zhig na bskyal nas 'dug (3na)gsung*/ phyag rjes mkhar dgu thog pa cig brtsigs/ mdo mangs gcig bzhengs/ khong lo ts+tsha ba chen po dus rtag tu mi bsgom pa ltar bzhugs kyang*/ rtag tu ting nge 'dzin las ma yengs par bzhugs pa yin/ chos nyid kyi bden pa gzigs pa yin te/ sprul pa lta bur bzhugs pa yin/ bu slob ma bas kyang yang slob bzang*/ bya ba la sogs pa'i lung ston pa yin gsung*/ de'i sras su gyur pa bla ma rngog gzhung pa yin te/ gzhon nu nas thos pa mang po byas/ de nas bla ma mar pa dang mjal/ spong dag lan gsum byas nas zhabs tog che bas bla mas gdams ngag ma lus par gnang ba yin/ rmi lam sgyu lus kyi sgo nas bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i zhal gzigs pa yin gsung ngo*/// /de gnyis kyi sras bla ma mi la ras pa yin te/ gung thang gi gdung rus mi la/ mtshan thos pa dga' bya ba yin te/ yab sras gnyis las med pas shin tu khas nyes te/ dbus su mthu tshol du phyin pas/ mthu mang po bslabs nas yar log /de nas gtsang rong du ston pa lha dga' bya ba la chos gsan pas/ ston pa na re khyod da re skyid/ dam chos rdzogs pa chen po theg pa thams cad kyi yang rtse/ man ngag thams cad kyi nying khu/ nang rtogs na nang sangs rgya/ nub rtogs na nub sangs rgya ba yod zer/ phyis bla ma mar pa byon pa thos pa dang*/ ston pa na re 'o cag gi chos 'di yang rtag tu bsgoms kyang skyed mi yong bar 'dug pas/ khyod mar pa lo ts+tsha ba zer ba gdams pa can zhig byon zer bas der song*/ nga na so rgas pas 'gro mi nus/ nus na 'gro ba yin te gsungs pa dang*/ bla ma mar pa'i snyan pa thos pas sngon gyi bag chags sad nas/ bla ma mar pa'i drung du (3ba)byon nas/ nga la rgyags kyang med chos dang zang zing gnyis ka zhu byas pas/ gnyis ka mi 'ong gang 'dod gsungs pas/ chos 'dod byas pas 'o na chu len pa la sogs pa gyis gsung*/

de nas ming mthu chen bya bar btags so// de'i nang par nas nye gnas su chud/ de'i lo rgyus mang du yang yod gsung*/ der bla ma mar pa lo lnga bsten/ sgrub brgyud kyi gdams ngag rnams zhus/ de nas rngog lo gcig bsten nas rngog gi dgra la ser ba phab nas zhabs tog byas/ zhu gtugs byas pas lhag chad med par byung bas/ bla ma mar pa la phyis dad pa cig byung gsung*/ de rim la phug tu mar me cig mgo thog tu bzhag nas bsgoms pas/ nam phyed tsam nas spyan phye bas dkar yal le 'dug nas/ nga la de ma thag tu yon tan zhig skyes snyam tsa na mar me brjed pa yin par 'dug gsung*/ yar yul du bzhud 'dod pa la bla mas bzhud ma ster/ der yang yang zhu ba byas pas bla mas gnang nas/ de nas gung thang du byon tsa na yum 'das nas lo mang po song 'dug /sngon gyi khang thog la rtswa skyes sgo kun yang har har por song*/ der gzims pas thugs shin tu mug par byung nas/ sang gi nyi ma la khang pa dang*/ zhing kha yod pa sngon gyi slob dpon sngags pa zhig la phul nas/ grong ltag gi dgon pa gcig tu byon nas 'og stan dang ma bral bar bsgoms gsung*/ brgyags ni med zwa la lto byas pas bla ma mdog sngon por song*/ khog ma dang phor pa gza' ru yang sngon por song*/ sring mo dang ne ne gnyis kyis nas phul bco lnga'i chang khyer nas byung*/ khong rang gnyis dang gsum kas 'thungs pas cher ma thub/ nyin cig khong rang gnyis nged kyi ming po 'di ci nyes pa yin 'di tsug song ba zer nas ngus pas/ der bla mas (4na)lus la bltas tsa na/ sha ye med par rus mgo lpags kyis g.yogs pa tsam du song nas 'dug /rkang skya btang nge tsam las mi 'dug /sngar de tsug ma rtogs gsung*/ de nas ri la gshegs nas ston btsas ma'i tshe/ yul mthong ba'i la khar byon pas btsas ma rnga nas 'dug /gnag lug thams cad kyis klungs bkang nas 'dug pas 'gro snying 'dod pa byung nas byon pas zho mar mang po ster ba byung gsung*/

der zhag gnyis gsum bzhugs pas skyo ba skyes nas yar ri la gshegs nas yun ring du bsgoms pas/ lo gsum na ras thub nas sring mo la gos bya ba mi dgos byas pas nga'i ming po grub pa thob zer nas dga'/ yang dus cig na rgyags zad nas yul na mar la slong du phyin tsa na/ cho ga byed pa cig gi sgo tsa na sprang po tshan pa cig 'dug pa'i gseb tu bzhugs tsa na/ gral nas sngags pa tshan cig chos gtam byed 'phro la/ gcig na re mi la rnal 'byor pa cig bsgom du song nas lo mang po lon/ de da lta grub pa thob nas yod zer ba la/ gcig na re de ngo mtshar che zhal blta dgos tshol du phyin na rnyed dam zer ba la/ gcig na re 'di rang na de ring 'dug zer/ de cang yin kho ri la bsgom pa la byas pas/ gcig na re de kho yin par ngo shes pa la zer/ 'o na de gang yin zer ba la/ bla ma la bzung nas 'di yin zer/ der nga'i mchod gnas byed zer zhing ma mthun pas nga re mi dgar byung gsung*/ der khong tsho lab la yengs kyi bar du bros nas cig car ri dgon la gshegs nas/ nyi ma rgyang tsa na phar rang byon nas/ yul du ye ma phyin par/ mang yul gung thang gi ri brag dkar rta so bya ba la yun ring du bzhugs nas dus cig gi tshe/ bla ma bsod nams che bas gung thang gi gnas chung gcig (4ba)gis phrag dog byas nas dma' phab pa'i ched du khong gi spyan drangs der byon pas/ btsun pa rnams kyis khyod grub pa thob pa yin pas nged kyi mchod gnas byed zer nas/ lha khang nang du bcug nas sgo lcags phyir drangs te/ phyi ru phyin tsa na bla ma yang byon 'dug /der yid ma ches nang du bltas tsa na nang du bzhugs 'dug pas/ der grub pa thob par shes pas btsun pa kun gyis bzod gsol byas so// de nas snye nam dang mang yul gnyis kyi ri la gshegs pa yin/ yang dus cig na rabs chad rgan rgon gnyis kyi mchod gnas byas te/ phye bre drug

/mar tshud bu gcig sha gzugs gcig bsnams nas la phyi gangs la gshegs pas/ dgun ril gyi kha ba byung nas/ der yul mi thams cad kyis rgan rgon gnyis la gyod brdal byas/ rgan rgon gnyis bla ma'i phyogs su kha lta yin ngu ba min pa gzhan med/ sang dpyid ka kha ba en cig zhu nas/ gal te rgya la bla ma ma 'das par yod pa dag srid dam byas nas mi gsum la rgyags phye dang*/ kha lham bskur nas tshol du btang bas/ mi gsum pos kha ba zhu ba'i la khar phyin nas bos pas/ bla ma'i thugs dgongs la mi ye mi yong*/ ri dwags yin dgongs pa la/ 'on kyang mi skad ji 'dra ji 'drar byung nas/ du ba btang der du ba mthong nas du ba'i drung du phyin tsa na bla ma bzhugs nas 'dug pas/ phye'i sum cha tsam cig 'dug /mar phyed tsam zhig 'dug /mi gsum po la byin/ zhag gsum tsam ngal gsos nas yul du byon tsa na/ lam du mi gsum po kha bas 'khyags nas bla ma'i drung du nyal bas dro bar byung zer/ der yul du byon pas yul mis phyag byas nas snyung gsol bas/ bla mas de'i tshe na la phyi gangs kyi mgur bzhengs pa yin gsung*/ (5na)yang dus cig na bla ma bal por thugs gtad nas dpon slob tshan cig gshegs pa la/ lam du tshong pa mang po dang phrad pas/ tshong dpon gyis bla ma'i sba mkhar la 'jus nas khyod su yin zer bas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ nga lta su yin cha yod dam// nga lta su yin ma shes na// nga ni mi la rnal 'byor yin// bya ba la sogs pa'i sba mkhar gyi mgur de bzhengs pa yin gsung*/ de nas yul mthong ba'i la kha cig tu byon/ nga yul du mi 'gro ri rtse 'grim du 'gro gsung*/ 'khor gyis nges par ri rtse cig 'grim na lo bcu na yang mi rtol na/ yul du gshegs par zhu byas pas ma gnang*/ mi la rnal 'byor ri ya ki la gshegs byas pas la stod du mi gces pa cig shi nas chos ston byed pa la/ mi mang po khrid nas btsal bas rnyed nas nga yul du spyan drangs/

der tshogs pa thams cad kyis kyang 'bul ba mang po byas/ yon bdag des yul la stod na dga' ba'i rta cig phul/ bla ma'i zhal nas khyed rang gi 'bul ba thams cad khyed rang gis khyer/ nga tshags mi byed pa yin gsungs pas der so sor khyer/ yon bdag de'i rta yang ma bzhes pas/ yon bdag des nga'i pha da gzod shi byas nas ngus pas bla ma'i zhal nas/ 'o na rta la gtad pa'i g.yang shun de nga la slongs gsung*/ de nas bkra shis tshe ring la gshegs nas bzhugs pa'i dus su/ dge bshes rnga sug pa/ 'bring ston 'phags pa/ jo sras mchod pa byas yul la stod na mi che ba gsum gyis bla ma btsal bas rnyed nas yul du spyan drangs/ bsnyen bkur ji ltar bgyis pa'i lo rgyus gsungs/ de nas bla ma gshegs par bzhed pa la/ 'khor gyis gshegs su ma ster nas/ phyis 'byon pa'i (5ba)dbu bsnyung bzhes pa dang*/ de nas gshegs tsa na/ mas yar rlung log ste spyi gtsug tu song ste/ kha sna'i dbugs rgyu ba chad nas/ der bsgoms pas bde ba snyam byed nas/ nam phyed tsa na bud med mang po bla ma'i mdun na thal mo sbyar nas/ bla ma la da rung thugs ma yengs par gyis zer/ bla mas thugs mar phab nas de ltar bsgoms pas/ en cig lon nas rlung gnas su tshud/ de nas phyin tsa na nyi ma zer la khad tsa na yang sngar bzhin byung nas/ yang bsgoms pas sor chud/ mi gnod snyam nas mna' dor ba yin pa la gnod par byung gsung*/ de nas brin snye nam gnyis kyi bar du/ brag dmar po mtho bya ba la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ 'og na thang dkar rgod po lding ba la sogs pa'i mgur bzhengs pa yin gsung*/ yang dus cig na bla ma nags kyi mthongs cig na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ yon bdag cig rtsar byung nas log nas song*/ bla mas bos pas byung*/ bar der khyod kyis gar bsdad byas pa la/ bla ma ni ma mthong mchod rten cig gi rtsar bsdad zer/ yang dus cig gi tshe na yon bdag cig phyag mi byed par cer ba cig bltas nas song*/

bla mas bos pas rtsar byung*/ khyod da ci phyag mi byed pa ci tsug yin byas pas/ bla ma gzims mal na mi gda' zer skad/ rin po ches bla ma la dus der ci mdzad zhus pas/ ngas cang byas pa med/ dī paṃ ka ras bsam yas dbu rtse'i rtse mo la bskor ba byed pa mis mthong zer te/ khong gi byas pa cang yod dam gsung*/ byas pa med kyang rten 'brel gyis gzhan snang la de ltar 'ong bar 'dug pa de bas na gzugs sku rnam gnyis kyang gzhan snang la ji ltar 'tshams par snang gis/ mdzad pa med pa yin gsungs/ yang dus zhig na brin gyi bkra shis tshe ring (6na)bya ba la byon nas/ 'khor tshan zhig dang 'grogs nas byon pas bla ma g.yang chen po cig la lhung bas/ rbab tu shor bas 'khor rnams kyis ngu yin mtha' rtsar phyin tsa na bla ma gyen la byon/ der 'khor rnams kyis g.yang de tsam pa la bla ma lhung ba la/ ma 'das par byon pa ci tsug yin zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas gzhan cig yin na sha dum bu chad de 'gro ste/ nga yang dga' rab byung gsung*/ yang dus cig na shel gyi mchod rten du byas nas/ nam mkha' la gshegs pa yin skad/ yang dus gcig na bla ma la bal po'i rong kha bzhi mi zhig gis mi la bltar 'ongs tsa na/ khong bla ma la ma dad nas mi la rnal 'byor pa khyod sgra che la don chung ba zhig 'dug /dge bshes bya ba ba ri lo ts+tsha ba la zer ba yin/ gdugs sam zangs dung ngam su phrad la gser ster lugs sam zer nas song*/ zhes zhag 'ga' na rong kha bzhi'i mi rnams bla ma nub re la lan gsum gsum nam mkha' la seng ge zhon nas 'byon yang zer/ byon pa yang mthong bas der shin tu dad nas/ bsnyen bkur byed pa mang po byung bas/ bla ma'i 'khor gyis khyed de brag gi mi ni mi smra/ da bsnyen bkur byed pa ci tsug yin byas pa la/ nged kyi nam mkha' na phar la bla ma nub re lan gsum gsum byon pas der dad pa yin zer lo// rin po che'i zhal nas/

de ngas phyin pa'i snga de'i lo yin gsung*/ mngon par shes pa'i sha ro bstan/ ma chung gang sdoms pas sngar ma 'thungs/ bud med gzhon nu ma la bu skye gsungs/ mgur mo'i mkhar ston gyis srang du phyin pa la/ kho na re nga'i rig pa 'di yin zer/ bud med cig na re khyod kyi bla ma la yon tan ci yod zer ba la/ khos ting nge 'dzin bzang po yod pa'am/ mngon par shes pa yod pa'am rtogs pa dang bral ba'i yon tan (6ba)brjod pas mo na re/ khyed kyi bla ma yon tan de shes pa cig 'dug gis zer nas kho la mgu ba la khyod kyis shes sam mthong ngam bya ba la/ mos mchan khung nas ra'i ze'u zhig phyung nas ngas gsol ba btab pa'i dus su/ 'dir bla ma nub re la lan gsum gsum 'byon pa yin pas/ ngas bla ma la mchod pa byed pa yin zer/ bud med de mkha' 'gro ma yin gsung*/ dus cig gi tshe na 'khor rnams dang 'grogs brin gyi lcags drang lung pa bya ba nas byon tsa na/ kha ba chen po byung ba la bla ma 'phur nas bzhud/ 'khor rnams kyis ye ma sleb zer/ rin po che la dris pa la/ 'phur ba ni min te ngas rkang pa en cig bteg gi byas/ rlung en cig mnan nas phyin pas/ bya rjes tsam las ma byung ba yin no gsung*/ rin po che zla ba bcu gsum bzhugs nas mar byon pa'i dus su/ yon bdag mo legs se'i khyim du bzhugs pa la/ bla ma la 'o cag gis rgyags bskyal mi dgos zer/ ci tsam bskyal byas pa las/ bre drug bskyal zer/ des ci tsam phyid byas pas/ zla ba re la nas 'bras phul gang res chog zer/ sngar ma rtogs pa bden nam rdzun nam dri snyam nas/ nyin lam gcig gi sa nas log nas phyin pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas khyod log gam gsungs nas/ ja cig bkol nas gnang*/ der zhus pas mo med tsa na mkha' 'gro mas zas sna chang sna la sogs pa yang dag pa stobs pas/ srin lag gis kha la reg tsam min pa med kyang*/ zhag lnga lnga drug drug lto za ba brjed nas mi dran/

res zhag re tsam ting nge 'dzin la song nas ma zos gsung*/ yang bla ma'i zhal nas brag mthon po'am/ mkhar mthon po'i rtse mo la zhag mang po bsgoms kyang yong bar 'dug gsung*/ yang dar ma bstan bya ba cig byes su song ba shi zer nas nye (7na)'brel rnams ngus pa las/ bla ma'i zhal nas ci nyes gsung*/ dar ma brtan shi zer nas ngu byas pa la/ ma shi kho da lta 'ong gsung*/ 'o na khong la de skad bgyi'am zhus pa la/ gyis gsung*/ de skad byas pas kho yid ches nas ngu 'phro bcad/ der kho byung gsung*/ de la sogs pa yon tan dpag tu med pa mnga'/ ting nge 'dzin las mi g.yo/ mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob la khyad par mi mnga'/ chos nyid bden pa gzigs pa sprul pa'i gang zag yin gsung*/ phyis 'das tsa na ti se dang*/ brin gnyis kar spur sbyangs pa yin gsung ngo*// bla ma mi las ji lta ba rtogs pa'i yon tan dang*/ mdzad spyod zur tsam rnam par bshad pa'o/// /bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang myur thob shog /bkra shis//
